locator: I q.2 a.3 co., tertia via: Si igitur omnia sunt possibilia non esse
interpretation: Collective reading of 'omnia': if all beings can not-be, it is possible that all at once are not. This is the premise the plenitude reading needs (relayWithoutCollectivePossibility shows it is needed). It is the modal counterpart of the quantifier shift ('each can not-be' to 'possibly none is'), so the plenitude reading relocates the quantifier-shift worry here rather than dissolving it.
